#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

cd "$(dirname "$0")/.."

npm ci

mkdir -p /workspace/.scotty/logs

if ! curl -fsS localhost:5173 >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  setsid nohup npm run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5173 > /workspace/.scotty/logs/vite.log 2>&1 < /dev/null &
fi

until curl -fs localhost:5173 >/dev/null; do
  sleep 1
done

echo "Ready: ${SCOTTY_HATCH/\{port\}/5173}"
